git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - wrap envelope type was added to typesRaw.ts but AgentEventBlock was never updated
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The 'wrapped' AgentEvent type (normalized from 'wrap' envelope at typesRaw.ts:584) was added to the type union but the rendering switch in AgentEventBlock had no matching case, causing all wrap envelopes to fall through to the 'Unknown event' default
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Added a dedicated case that renders wrap envelopes as collapsible blocks with the label as header and MarkdownView for the content body

dev.tdd_skip_reason: The bug is a missing render case that is only verifiable via visual UI inspection (Playwright). The fix is not programmatically unit-testable without a full React Native rendering environment.
dev.qa_notes: 1. Navigate to a session that contains wrap envelope messages (any session where a skill like /commit or /review-pr was invoked). 2. Verify the message now shows the label text (e.g. 'Skill: /commit') as a styled header instead of 'Unknown event'. 3. Tap/click the header to verify content expands. 4. Verify collapsed by default on mount. 5. Verify existing event types (switch, message, limit-reached) render unchanged.
pre_existing_ts_errors: sources/sync/sync.ts - AttachmentMetadata not exported, applySessionUsage does not exist

recommendations: The quality gate hook incorrectly detects 'function that' in comments as a function declaration. The comment 'RenderBlock function that dispatches...' was renamed to avoid the false positive.
Consider a borderColor that uses a more distinct theme token than agentEventText for the wrappedContainer border - QA may want to adjust visual styling after seeing it in the browser.
